# State Management Requirements Checklist: SPEC-009C3 - Dev/Review/Aegis to Ready for Owner

**Purpose**: Validate SPEC-009C3 state-transition and state-ownership requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-05-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the owner-ready state subject and PR owner defined as the `mission-control_dev_implementation` task rather than helper, root, review, owner-review, or Aegis tasks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, §SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are state requirements defined for review `fix` blocking Aegis advancement, owner-review advancement, and `ready_for_owner` before any readiness side effect occurs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are state requirements defined for Aegis `rejected` blocking owner-ready state while preserving bounded retry evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK004 Does the plan/contract define how SPEC-009C3 guards the static `mission-control_review.next_template_slug` fallback so review `fix` cannot create the configured `mission-control_owner_review` successor? [Resolved, Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §State-Management Decision, Contract §C3 Review Transition Guard]
- [x] CHK005 Does the plan/contract define how review `pass` reaches the Aegis approval/readiness gate without making the stable `mission-control_owner_review` slug the C3 happy-path successor, owner-ready task, or PR owner? [Resolved, Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §State-Management Decision, Contract §C3 Review Transition Guard]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Are primary, failed-review, failed-Aegis, retry, missing-evidence, wrong-workspace, governance-blocked, fixture-only, and out-of-scope merge/done state scenarios addressed? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-001..§SC-009]

## Notes

- CHK004 and CHK005 were resolved by adding explicit C3 review-transition guard language to the plan and contract: review `fix` suppresses the static review successor fallback, while review `pass` bypasses owner-review and evaluates the Aegis/readiness gate against the PR-producing dev task.
